column1: # Species-aware BUSCO lineage (W2.3). After the identification call, stage 08b re-runs
# BUSCO/compleasm with the most specific OrthoDB v10 lineage that matches the species call:
# an exact species match wins, then the genus, else fungi_odb10 (the lineage of the early QC).
# Columns: taxon (genus or "Genus species"), lineage (BUSCO v5 odb10 name), rank.
# Lineages must be staged under <data_dir>/busco (bin/fetch_references.sh busco); a lineage
# that is not staged makes the stage record `skipped`, it never downloads at run time.
